title: GEKKO-AI Observatory: AI exposure, adoption, impact scenarios and risk scoring for Luxembourg's financial sector
description: Open, reproducible toolkit linking task-level AI exposure, adoption, Monte-Carlo impact scenarios to 2030 and an AI risk taxonomy aligned with the EU AI Act, DORA and FSB vulnerabilities, for Luxembourg's financial sector. Developed by Gekko & Co. Capital SCSp under the research project 'Artificial Intelligence and the Transformation of Luxembourg's Financial Sector: Impacts, Opportunities and Risks'.
